author: Lori Morrison
text: Michael Lee Septic Services is the only service I use in the Livingston, Texas area. It is a family owned and backed business that is professional, prompt, and informative. They always give a perfect synopsis of what I can do to keep my septic system healthy. The cost is reasonable and affordable. I am so pleased that I use Michael Lee's service and that I don't ever have to worry about septic problems!

author: AnthJack
text: Michael Lee Septic Clean is quick, thorough and professional. Equipment is well-maintained and timely appointments

author: Karen Argueta
text: Called on a holiday weekend was able to get service next day called me and was here within 15 minutes. Vance provided great customer service was able to tell me how to maintain it and advised when to call back for service for another septic clean out. Very happy over all and price was communicated right away no surprises will recommend to others!

author: Ann Girl
text:
They were awesome!!
Bought this home a year ago in Woodville and decided to service the septic so I  contacted Michael and they came and pumped it but it was so bad they had to go empty the truck in Livingston and come back to Woodville.
I thought the price would be expensive as most things are now days but was pleasantly surprised it was very affordable!
They guys were very informative and helpful.
Highly recommend them.

author: Mark
text: I called late friday afternoon and I wasn't in a hurry for Vance to come out to my home to clean my septic system, I would have waited until the next week. But Vance came out  this same day  in the evening.  to help me on my system, He cleaned and answered my 20 questions lol even the silly ones. with a professional and friendly manor. The price was fair and he is honest and professional  I'll use Vance again and tell anyone needing his service to call. Thank you again Vance
